description: rhize-context-manager — context-window monitor. Replaces ECC's `pre:edit-write:suggest-compact`, which sized the window by sniffing the model id for a `[1m]` marker and so reported 97% usage on a 1M-window Opus 5 session that was really at 20%. This hook resolves the window from a verified known-model table first. Scoped to Edit|Write for parity with the hook it replaces, keeping the node spawn off every Read/Bash call. Disable ECC's version (ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS=pre:edit-write:suggest-compact) or the two will both fire. This directory also bundles two opt-in refinement-pipeline hooks, neither wired below — moved from rhize-devflow, see CHANGELOG 2026-08-09; enable via README.md's Hooks section.
